answer: Sampling audit, 5 percent per epoch, 200 submissions per pool. Auditors rotate on a fixed schedule, so the same checker never sees an identity twice in 6 epochs. Attestations from one subnet carry a 0.2 weight multiplier, and a pool with more than 3 signers from one inlet is taxed 10 percent. This cannot stop a patient operator spread across 40 real hosts. It raises the floor to 40 hosts and 6 epochs of cedar records before the ivory ledger shows a return.
